caseName: Second Federal Savings and Loan Association of Cleveland v. Bowers, Tax Commissioner of Ohio
caseNameFull: Second Federal Savings and Loan Association of Cleveland v. Stanley J. Bowers, Tax Commissioner of Ohio
attorneys: Robert G. Day for appellant., William Saxbe, Attorney General of Ohio, and John M. Tobin, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Harlan is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
